nonBlockingIssues.description: Comment in app/src/mqtt_client.rs line 606 says 'Build and publish one entity at a time' but build_with_retain() creates all 20 configs in a Vec simultaneously before iterating. No worse than old code, just misleading comment.
The 'Last Fault' sensor lacks entity_category: 'diagnostic' — correct per validation contract spec but arguably should have it.

ConfigurationResponse (0x94) is never generated by SpaSim (always 0x2E ControlConfiguration), so last_config() accessor and ConfigurationResponse event variant have no end-to-end test coverage. Sim tooling gap, not a bug.
